Declaration of Restrictions and a Single Zoning Lot and Easement Agreement AGREEMENT, made this _7 Q_ day of November, 2004, between L&S Realty of Massapequa, Inc., a New York corporation, having an office at 70 Broadway, Hicksville, New York, ("L&S") and CCW, Inc., a New York corporation, having an office at 109 Lafayette Street,Suite 109,NewYork,NewYork("CCw"). WHEREAS, L&S is the owner in fee simple of certain land and the buildings and improvements thereon, generally known as 90 Fulton Street, Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York (Block 77, Lot 23 on the New York City Tax Map), more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto (hereinafter referred to as "L&S's land"); and WHEREAS, CCW is the Owner in fee simple of certain land and the buildings and improvements thereon, generally known as 92 Fulton Street, Borough of Manhattan, City. County and State of New York (Block 77, Lot 22 on the New York City Tax Map), more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto (hereinafter referred to as "CCW's land"); and WHEREAS, CCW intends to rehabilitate the building existing on CCW's Land (hereinafter "CCW's Building"); and WHEREAS, after the rehabilitation, CCW's Building is expected to contain more floor area(hereinafter"Floor Area"),as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961, as amended (hereinafter the "Zoning Resolution") than would be permitted under the Zoning Resolution on CCW's land alone as a separate zoning lot, with theresult that for the consideration stated and subject to and on the conditions setforth in the Purchase Agreement dated simultaneously herewith (hereafter called the "Purchase Contract"), between CCW and L&S, CCW wishes to purchase from L&S a portion of the Floor Area attributable to the L&S's land under the Zoning Resolution which is not used as of the date of this agreement and wishes to combine L&S's land and CCW's land into a single combined zoning lot under the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS,a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter the "Declaration"), a copy of which is attached hereto as Schedule C-1 or a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (hereinafter the "Waiver"),a copy of which is attached hereto as Schedule C-2 has been executed by L&S, CCW, and all other "parties in interest" (as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution) to L&S's land and CCW's land which combines the said land into a single combined zoning lot (hereinafter the "Combined Lot");and WHEREAS, CCW wishes to purchase from the L&S and the L&S wishes to grant and sell to CCW for the benefit of CCW's land a certain perpetual easement and other rights over L&S'slandwhicharehereinafterdescribed.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, the mutual promises contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, receipt of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1.Subject to the provisions of paragraph 3 hereof, L&S hereby grants, sells and conveys forever to CCW a perpetual easement for light and air commencing ten (10) feet over and above the building presently situated on L&S's land described in Schedule A (hereinafter the "Easement Area"); provided that L&S may continue to maintain, replace and repair fixtures and equipment now existing over and above said horizontal plane and on the roof of the building on L&S's land. CCW is also granted an easement for balconies hereinafter constructed on CCW's Building to 2.L&S covenants that, except as provided in this Agreement, no building or other structureorinstallationorfixtureshallbeerectedorallowedtoexistoverandabovethe horizontal plane and within the Easement Area, nor shall L&S increase the size or bulk of its existingbuilding. Floor Area that is attributable under the Zoning Resolution to L&S's land as a separate zoning lot and that is not used in L&S's land as of the date of this Agreement (such unused floor area is hereinafter referred to as the "Excess Zoning Rights").L&S hereby reserves unto itself all Excess Zoning Rights in excess of eight thousand (8,ooo) square feet and consents to the incorporation in the CCW's Building of not more than eight thousand (8,0oo) square feet of the Excess Zoning Rights pursuant to this Agreement and to the extent permitted by applicable law. (b)Notwithstanding anything contained in this agreement to the contrary, L&S may, on its own land,utilize all or any part of the Excess Zoning Rights which exceed eight thousand (8,000) square feet to the extent permitted by applicable law, including all density and bulk requirements; and such rights may be developed on any portion of L&S's land, in compliance with all applicable laws, codes, rules and regulations, including at any point above the present height of the building thereon without in any way violating the easement referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 hereof. 4. In connection with any work to be done on CCW's land, CCW shall, at its own cost and expense: (i) use and cause all persons, firms or corporations and their respective employees or subcontractors, performing work at or supplying materials to CCW's Building, to use such means of excavation and construction, and procedures therefor, as are appropriate fully to protect against any physical damage to L&S's land or to the utilities serving L&S's land arising from any demolition, excavation or construction activities for CCW's Building; (ii) comply with all applicable codes, statutes and ordinances; (i) name L&S as an additional insured on the builder's risk insurance policy maintained in connection with such work; and
